paper_style.palette_strategy: histogram 统一使用蓝色渐变并以红/橙阈值线强调早期区间；heatmap 用橙/蓝/绿离散状态；method diagram 用紫/绿/黄流程语义；主结果表用浅蓝 Prophet 背景、红绿 gain 和橙色 speedup；消融/配置表保持黑白。

paper_style.style_consistency: 表格内部均采用 minimal/booktabs 线条，Figure 1/4 的 histogram 语法高度一致；跨对象字体不完全统一（Times New Roman histogram、Nimbus/Computer Modern 表格、Helvetica/Menlo diagram），跨对象也没有统一方法色。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Distribution of early correct answer detection during decoding process.. Histograms show when correct answers first emerge during diffusion decoding, measured as percentage of total decoding steps, using LLaDA 8B on GSM8K. Red and orange dashed lines indicate 50% and 70% completion thresholds, with corresponding statistics showing substantial early convergence. Suffix prompting (b,d) dramatically accelerates convergence compared to standard prompting (a,c). This early convergence pattern demonstrates that correct answer tokens stabilize as top-1 candidates well before full decoding.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Decoding dynamics across all positions based on maximum-probability predictions. Heatmaps track how the top-1 token changes at each position, if it is decoded at the current step, over the course of decoding. (a) Without our suffix prompts, correct answer tokens reach maximum probability at step 119. (b) With our suffix prompts, this occurs earlier at step 88, showing that the model internally identifies correct answers well before the final output. Results are shown for LLaDA 8B solving problem index 700 from GSM8K under low-confidence decoding. Gray indicates positions where the top-1 prediction remains unchanged, orange marks positions where the prediction changes to a different token, blue denotes the step at which the corresponding y-axis position is actually decoded, and green box highlights the answer region where the correct answer remains stable as the top-1 token and can be safely decoded without further changes as the decoding process progresses.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: An illustration of the Prophet’s early-commit-decoding mechanism. (a) Standard full-step decoding completes all predefined steps (e.g., 10 steps), incurring redundant computations after the answer has stabilized (at t=6). (b) Prophet dynamically monitors the model’s confidence (the “Confidence Gap”). It triggers an early commit decoding as soon as the answer converges, saving a significant portion of the decoding steps (in this case, 55%) without compromising the output quality.

cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 1/4 共用 histogram caption 句式，Figure 2/3 的 encoding key 较完整；Figure 5 过短；Table 1 caption 最完整，Table 2–4 的子表语义较依赖正文。Figure 1/4 的 50/70% 阈值文字与图面 25/50% 不一致，Table 3 有双句号。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 使用模型 superheader 加 Full/Prophet/Speedup；Table 2/3 使用并列子表；Table 4/6/7 使用简单列头；Table 5 使用 Stage+stream。主结果表加入浅蓝/红绿/橙色语义，消融与配置表保持黑白。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Eq. (4) 定义 confidence gap，Eq. (5) 定义 staged threshold，Algorithm 1 定义 check/return；Figure 3 是方法接口，Table 1/2 测试质量与 speedup，Table 3/4 检验预算、remasking、block granularity，Table 7 检验 controller form；Figure 5 补足“何时不退出”的 failure-side evidence。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文放 Figure 1–3、Table 1–4 的现象、接口、主比较与消融；附录用 Figure 4 复核 MMLU、Table 5 展示轨迹、Figure 5 展示错误分布、Table 6–7 给配置与 schedule 对照。附录延伸了证据链，却没有补 seed、硬件、runtime、n 或 uncertainty。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 主导页面正文和表格；histogram notebook 使用 Times New Roman；Figure 3 混入 Helvetica、Tahoma、Menlo 和 Apple Color Emoji；Table 5 混入 Sans/Mono token styling。表格内一致，跨图谱系混合。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 1/4 共用蓝渐变与红橙参考线，Figure 2 用橙/蓝/绿状态，Figure 3 用紫/绿/黄流程，Table 1 用浅蓝 Prophet 与红绿 gain。对象内语义清楚；跨对象没有统一 Prophet/Full brand color。

most_reusable_patterns: 2×2 条件 histogram + 统一早期阈值 + 累计比例，再用单例 heatmap 解释位置级机制。
full-step/early-commit 对齐 timeline 把停止条件、冗余区和出口显式串起来。
主表固定 Full→Prophet (Δ)→Speedup，附录配置表和最小 schedule ablation 支撑复现。
提前停止主张同时给出正确样本早期稳定和错误样本末期变化的互补证据。
highest_value_objects: Table 3–4：static budget 与 block granularity boundaries。
failure_patterns: Figure 1/4 caption 阈值与图面/源码不一致。
多数图表没有 n、seed、误差或区间。
Figure 2/5 是单例或条件分布，外推边界需正文限定。
Table 2 左右子表成本列不对称；Table 6 与 §5.1 的 generation-length 口径未解释。
颜色与混合字体在灰度、小尺寸下可读性下降；公开仓库未提供 Figure 3/5 或 Table 源。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以蓝色 early-convergence 分布为入口，经单例 heatmap 和停止时间线进入 Prophet，再用分组主表、正交组合表和预算/粒度消融把速度—质量主张收束到附录的失败机制与复现配置。
